name: suppa-dev-agent
description: Suppa-aware development for GitHub Copilot: registers the Suppa MCP server and installs the Suppa Dev Engineer agent, prompts, and engineering instructions.

commands.title: Suppa: Install workspace customizations (agent, prompts, instructions)

suppaDevAgent.command.description: Command used to launch the Suppa MCP server (e.g. python, python3, or an absolute interpreter path).

suppaDevAgent.serverCwd.description: Absolute path to the suppa2.0-mcp-server folder. If empty, the extension looks for it in the open workspace.

suppaDevAgent.lang.description: Language passed to the Suppa MCP server (SUPPA_LANG).

suppaDevAgent.timezone.description: Timezone passed to the Suppa MCP server (SUPPA_TZ).
